title: 1.1 World Wide Web
description: The Web, its foundations and uses

questions.question: What is the World Wide Web (www) best described as?
The Internet is best described as which of the following?
The Web runs on which of the following?
The Web is a collection of which of the following?
Which software is used to access the Web over the Internet?
Who invented the Web?
In which year was the Web invented?
The Web was invented at which laboratory?
CERN is a famous laboratory located in which country?
When the Web was invented, it was formed out of how many essential foundations?
Which of the following lists the four essential foundations of the Web?
options: HTML, HTTP, a web server, and a web browser
HTML, email, FTP, and a web browser
HTTP, CSS, JavaScript, and a web server
Email, file transfer, communication, and a web browser
questions.correctAnswer: HTML, HTTP, a web server, and a web browser

questions.question: What does HTML stand for?
HTML is used for which of the following?
What does HTTP stand for?
HTTP is best described as which of the following?
options: The set of rules that web browsers and web servers use to communicate with each other
The language used to create webpages
A publicly accessible collection of webpages
questions.correctAnswer: The set of rules that web browsers and web servers use to communicate with each other

questions.question: What is a web browser?
options: Software used by users to view webpages
Software that stores webpages and responds to user requests
The language used to create webpages
A set of rules for communication
questions.correctAnswer: Software used by users to view webpages

questions.question: What is a web server?
options: Software that stores webpages and responds to user requests
Software used by users to view webpages
The language used to create webpages
questions.correctAnswer: Software that stores webpages and responds to user requests

questions.question: A website is best described as which of the following?
options: A publicly accessible collection of interrelated webpages
questions.correctAnswer: A publicly accessible collection of interrelated webpages

questions.question: Websites help an organization do which of the following?
options: Expand its reach to the entire world
Limit its audience to one country
questions.correctAnswer: Expand its reach to the entire world

questions.question: How have websites benefited shoppers through e-commerce?
options: They order products from home, which reduces travel cost and saves time
They must visit shops in person to order products
They pay higher prices for products
They can no longer order products online
questions.correctAnswer: They order products from home, which reduces travel cost and saves time

questions.question: Which government e-service example is given in the textbook?
options: Applying for passports online at the Immigration Nationality & Vital Events Agency
questions.correctAnswer: Applying for passports online at the Immigration Nationality & Vital Events Agency

questions.question: Which website is mentioned as making educational resources accessible to students?
options: The Ethiopian Ministry of Education website
questions.correctAnswer: The Ethiopian Ministry of Education website

questions.question: Online learning became especially widespread following which event?
options: The launch of the WHO website

questions.question: True or False: The Web and the Internet are the same thing.
True or False: Tim Berners-Lee invented the Web in 1989 at CERN.
True or False: HTTP is the set of rules that web browsers and web servers use to communicate with each other.
True or False: A web browser is software that stores webpages and responds to user requests.
True or False: The Internet provides services such as email and file transfer in addition to the Web.
